verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. In both, the crowd illustration, which is the original's main image, is shrunk to a thin strip at the top where the figures are tiny and lose their impact. The quote is blown up so far that it wraps into 9 ragged lines ('THOUGHTFUL' and 'CHANGE THE' stand alone), and the attribution sits close to the bottom edge. Otherwise the text is readable, left-aligned on a shared margin and on brand.
